sections.description:
Stop searching for separate plugins. Create any widget you need in seconds with AI.

TalkGenAI is not just another AI chat; it is a functional widget factory. Whether you need a complex Cost Calculator, a scarcity Countdown Timer, or an interactive Checklist, simply tell the AI what you want, and it builds the tool for you instantly.

👋 WHY USE TALKGENAI?

Most WordPress sites need interactive tools to engage visitors. Usually, you have to download one plugin for a calculator, another for a timer, and a third for a to-do list. This slows down your site.

TalkGenAI replaces 10+ plugins. It uses advanced Artificial Intelligence (GPT-4o & Claude 3.5 Sonnet) to write the code for you, ensuring lightweight, fast, and custom tools for your site.

🏆 REPLACES THESE PLUGINS

By installing TalkGenAI, you can often deactivate:
* ❌ Cost Calculator Builders
* ❌ Mortgage Calculator Plugins
* ❌ Countdown Timer Ultimate
* ❌ Simple To-Do List Plugins
* ❌ ROI & Finance Calculator Widgets
* ❌ HTML/JS Snippet inserters

🚀 WHAT CAN YOU BUILD? (Use Cases)

You can generate unlimited tools. Here are the most popular high-traffic use cases:

🧮 POWERFUL CALCULATORS

Don’t buy expensive calculator plugins. Just ask TalkGenAI to build:
* Mortgage Calculator: Calculate monthly payments with interest rates.
* BMI Calculator: Health and fitness body mass index tools.
* ROI Calculator: Show clients their return on investment.
* Cost Estimator / Quote Generator: Let users estimate service costs (Web design, Renovation, etc.).
* Loan & Finance Calculators: Auto loans, savings goals, and currency converters.

⏳ COUNTDOWN TIMERS & SCARCITY

Boost your conversions with urgency tools:
* Sales Countdown: Timer for Black Friday or flash sales.
* Launch Timer: “Coming Soon” countdowns for new products.
* Evergreen Timers: Personal timers that reset for each visitor.
* Event Countdowns: Days left until a webinar or conference.

✅ TO-DO LISTS & CHECKLISTS

Engage users with interactive content:
* User Onboarding Checklist: Guide users through steps.
* Shopping Lists: Interactive lists for e-commerce.
* Process Trackers: Simple progress bars and task completion.

✨ KEY FEATURES

  • 100% AI-Powered: No complex settings panels. Just type: “Create a BMI calculator with metric units.”
  • Instant Shortcodes: The plugin generates a simple shortcode to place anywhere (Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, etc.).
  • Fully Customizable: Want to change the color? Just tell the AI: “Make the button blue.”
  • Lightweight Code: Unlike heavy builder plugins, this generates only the code you need.
  • Responsive Design: All generated tools look great on mobile and desktop.
  • Secure & Fast: Generated code is validated and runs efficiently on your site.

💡 HOW TO USE

  1. Open the TalkGenAI dashboard.
  2. Type your request (e.g., “Create a calorie calculator for women”).
  3. Preview the widget generated instantly by AI.
  4. Copy the Shortcode and paste it into any Page or Post.

🎁 Free Plan (Included)

Get started immediately with our generous free tier:
* ✅ 10 Free Generations per month
* ✅ 5 Active Apps
* ✅ GPT-4o-mini Model (Fast & Efficient)
* ✅ All App Types Included

💎 Starter Plan (Optional – $20/mo)

Upgrade for power features:
* 🚀 50 Generations per month
* 🚀 Premium AI Models (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet)
* 🚀 20 Active Apps
* 🚀 “Get App Ideas” Feature (AI analyzes your site for ideas)
* 🚀 White Label (Remove branding)
* 🚀 Use on Unlimited Websites

⚠️ Privacy & Data Collection (GDPR Compliant)

This plugin connects to an external API service (TalkGenAI) to provide AI functionality.

1. Service Provider Information:
* Service: TalkGenAI (Israel)
* Service URL: https://app.talkgen.ai
* Terms of Service: Read Terms
* Privacy Policy: Read Privacy Policy

2. What Data We Collect:
To provide the service, we collect and process the following data:
* App Descriptions: The text prompts you enter to generate apps.
* Technical Info: WordPress site URL, WordPress version, PHP version (for compatibility).
* Usage Data: Timestamp of requests, IP address (for security/abuse prevention), and User ID.

3. What Data We Do NOT Collect:
* ❌ We do NOT access your site’s database, posts, or pages.
* ❌ We do NOT collect user passwords or personal credentials.
* ❌ We do NOT access data from other plugins.

4. User Responsibility:
You are responsible for reviewing and testing all generated applications before publishing them. AI can make mistakes; always verify calculations and ensuring content compliance.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “TalkGenAI”
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate
  5. Register at https://app.talkgen.ai to get your free API key
  6. Enter your API key in TalkGenAI > Settings
  7. Navigate to TalkGenAI > Generate App to start creating!

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now
  5. Click Activate Plugin
  6. Register at https://app.talkgen.ai to get your free API key
  7. Enter your API key in TalkGenAI > Settings
  8. Navigate to TalkGenAI > Generate App to start creating!
sections.faq:
How do I set up TalkGenAI? (Video Tutorial)

Watch our step-by-step video guide: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dl5mx1U2DB0

This video covers installation, API key setup, and generating your first app.

Do I need an API key?

Yes! Register for free at https://app.talkgen.ai to get your key. The free plan includes 10 generations every month.

Can I create a Mortgage Calculator with this?

Yes! Simply type “Create a mortgage calculator with inputs for loan amount, interest rate, and term” and the AI will build it.

Does it work with Elementor?

Yes. TalkGenAI generates standard WordPress shortcodes that work in Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder, and the Gutenberg Block Editor.

Do I need to know coding?

No. The AI writes the HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for you. You just describe what you need in plain English (or any language).

Can I save my calculators?

Yes, all generated tools are saved and can be managed from the plugin dashboard.

2.4.1 – 2025-12-18

  • 🐛 Fix: “Keep Calculator” now reliably closes the overlay popup in the admin preview

  • 🔒 Security Enhancement: Removed external CDN dependency (SweetAlert2) – now using custom modal system
  • 🐛 Critical Fix: “Get App Ideas” now shows proper upgrade modal for free users instead of technical error
  • ✨ New Feature: Added “Generate New” button for quick app generation workflow
  • ✨ New Feature: Added clickable example prompts that auto-fill chat input
  • 🎨 UX Improvement: User-friendly error messages – no more technical “Authorization header” errors
  • 🎨 UX Improvement: Custom modal system for API key errors and premium feature prompts
  • 🎨 UX Improvement: Auto-adds https:// to URLs in “Get App Ideas” feature
  • 🎨 UX Improvement: Success message when saving API key for the first time
  • 🎨 UX Improvement: Swapped button positions (Save App / Get App Ideas) for better workflow
  • 🎨 UX Improvement: Empty state design now matches app.talkgen.ai branding
  • ✅ Compatibility: Tested with WordPress 6.9
  • 🧹 Code Quality: Removed all debug logging for production readiness

  • ⚠️ Users now see specific messages for Anthropic or OpenAI overload/rate limit errors

2.2.0 – 2025-11-30

  • 🎁 Added support for bonus credits that give users access to Premium AI features
  • 🎁 Free users with bonus credits can now access Advanced AI modules (GPT-4, Claude Sonnet 4.5)

1.0.0 – 2025-10-19

  • 🎉 Initial Release
  • ✅ AI-powered app generation with OpenAI and Anthropic
  • ✅ Template library for instant app creation
  • ✅ Live preview functionality
  • ✅ Shortcode support for easy embedding
  • ✅ Automatic site registration with free monthly credits
  • ✅ Security validation and content sanitization
  • ✅ WordPress 6.4 compatibility
  • ✅ PHP 8.2 compatibility

  • ✅ Usage tracking and analytics
